Crab Breeze sound effects · works sheet 2 · 2026-10-25

Crab Breeze Sounds

36 sounds for the mech, its weapons, what they hit and the cockpit. 30 are cut from real recordings (CC0 packs from OpenGameArt and Kenney: a mech stomp, rocket motors, ship cannons, gunshots, explosions, steam), slowed and layered to a 24 m machine; the cockpit tones and a few others are synthesised. Cues marked rec are recorded.

Cues 36Recorded 30Synthesised 6Format mono 44.1 kHz OGGLicence CC0 and ours

Each recorded cue names its originals in assets/audio/sfx/SOURCES.md. Not in the game yet: playing them is the sound plan (openspec/changes/audio).

Cuts: tools/audio/cut_cc0.py to tools/audio/cc0_cues.json · Synthesis: tools/audio/gen_sfx.py · Encode: tools/audio/render_sfx.sh · Game copies: assets/audio/sfx/*.ogg · Plans: openspec/changes/audio, weapon-kinds, multi-lock Sources for recorded replacements and their licences: docs/analysis/audio-sources.md
